text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy. An integrated junior and senior high school dedicated to raising Umamusume who will shine in Umamusume races—the Twinkle Series.

Umamusume with extraordinary talent gather at this academy from all over the country. However...
many end up finishing their careers without ever securing a single victory.
Even so, they continue to run, pursuing the view from the summit. And among them—

Buena Vista is
sparkling and radiant.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, feeling good.
I'm off!"

Basking in the full sunlight, she runs.
Her form, her footwork—everything is well above passing,
but what truly stands out is the sharpness of her final burst of speed.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
Yaaaaah!!

Her flying sprint, unthinkable from such a
slender frame—it makes my heart flutter.
Cheerful and bright, she radiates a dazzling presence that extends far beyond the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: English Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, Buena Vista-san.
Please translate 'Where should I go to get my horseshoes fixed?'
into English."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um, a horseshoe is a 'cleat', so...
"Where should I go to get
my cleats repaired?" ...Right!

text_block_list.name: English Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your grammar and pronunciation are both flawless.
Full marks.

My grades were top-notch, and the teachers thought highly of me.
Not only that—

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
W-What's wrong, Buena-chan...?!
...Did you make her cry by any chance...?

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you've got it wrong!? I was just talking about
how the teacher praised me for cleaning up earlier—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu~...!
I'm just so, so happy, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You always made sure to clean properly,
even the parts no one could see.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm glad they understood...!

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
...Ehehe, yeah, thank you!

Buena Vista is deeply empathetic.
She can truly understand others' circumstances and shed tears for them.
That's precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Buena-chan!
Bye-by~e!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Bye-byee!
See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan is... an honor student, talented at
running, and super popular. To think someone
that perfect actually exists.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
She really feels like an unreachable flower on a high peak.

—“An unattainable flower.”
Indeed, those words suit her perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It still tickles a bit, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Because you've always been my "big brother."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Because you've always been my "big sister."

Buena Vista—a girl with an undeniably brilliant
future waiting ahead of her... She is my trainee,
and—my childhood friend.

I first met her when we were still very young.
When I moved in next door,
her family welcomed me with open arms.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Buena, you have something you want to give to <username>-kun, don't you?
……Go on.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Buena, you have something you want to give to <username>-chan, don't you?
……Go on.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Um, you see... Big Brother.
Here.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Um, you see... Big Sister.
Here.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Buu-chan wants to...
play with Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Buu-chan wants to...
play with Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Buu-chan wants to say hello.
A friendly, friendly hello...
choice_data_list: Thank you! I'll take good care of it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yeah.
Hey, play with me, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yeah.
Hey, play with me, Big Sister!
She was like a little sister, always bouncing along behind me. My perception of her completely changed the first time I saw her running all out—

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: BAM! ...Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah, not yet!!
Yaaaaahhhhh--!!

Because that run was so dazzling,
shining with such brilliance...
—a grand dream was planted in a young heart.

"‘Someday, I'll become Buena Vista's
trainer’—"
The day I finally confessed that dream to her. With tears welling slightly in her eyes... she smiled at me.

Following after her entry into Tracen Academy,
I successfully became a Trainer... and proved my resolve.
And then came the moment our first dream came true.
choice_data_list: Will you sign with me as your trainer?
Will you sign with me as your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Yes, absolutely. My Trainer!
"I'm finally at the starting line. From here on out... we'll fulfill our dream together, hand in hand."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Shall we get going soon? Did you bring the documents?

Our debut date in the Twinkle Series was finally set.
After this, I was just about to go submit the
necessary paperwork.
choice_data_list: Ah, but let me confirm one more time.
Ah, but let me double-check one more time.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But when you showed me yesterday,
it didn't seem like there was any problem...
choice_data_list: It's an important first step, so I want to make it perfect!
It's an important first step, so I want to make it perfect.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You really do treasure it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(You truly are dependable.
Both now—and in the past...)

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I get to debut with you, <username>!
I'm so glad.
...Though, somehow, I had a feeling it would turn out this way.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I get to debut with you, <username>!
I'm so glad.
...Though, somehow, I had a feeling it would turn out this way.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"After all, you've always been glued to her side ever since you were little...
You were inseparable, weren't you?
...Some things never change."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: M-Mom...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(—Yes, we were inseparable.
Ever since we met, the whole time...
Because I always wanted to be by your side.)

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Onii-chan!
Wait for meee...!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Onee-chan!
Wait for meee...!

text_block_list.name: Big Brother
text_block_list.text: "Buena, did you follow me here...?!"

text_block_list.name: Big Sister
text_block_list.text: "Buena, you followed me all the way here...?!"

text_block_list.name: Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text: "Hold on a sec... What are we gonna do with such a little kid? We can't go on an adventure like this!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But...
Buu-chan is with big brother...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But...
Buu-chan is with big sister...

text_block_list.name: Big Brother
text_block_list.text:
"Buena, it's alright. Let's go together!
I'll protect you, so don't worry and just follow me."

text_block_list.name: Big Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Buena, it's alright. Let's go together!
I'll protect you, so don't worry and just follow me."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Because you
were strong and so cool.)

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... *sniff*,
ugh... Mommy... where are youuu...?

text_block_list.name: Big Brother
text_block_list.text: "Found you! Buena...!"

text_block_list.name: Big Sister
text_block_list.text: "Found you! Buena...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
...!
Big brother...?!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
...!
Big sister...?!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're covered in mud...?
Are you okay...?

text_block_list.name: Big Brother
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, I took a spill while running...
Come on, let's head back. Everyone's waiting."

text_block_list.name: Big Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, I took a spill while running...
Come on, let's head back. Everyone's waiting."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Because you were... exceptionally kind,
and a truly... wonderful person.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I really want to live up to it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Your expectations. Your dreams.
I want to make every single one come true. If I do that—)

text_block_list.name: Big Brother
text_block_list.text:
"You're amazing, Buena! So amazing, so amazing...!
Your running is truly—so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Big Sister
text_block_list.text:
"You're amazing, Buena! So amazing, so amazing...!
Your running is truly—so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(—You'll show me those sparkling eyes
again, won't you?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing!
So, how did the paperwork look?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then...
I'll write first, okay?
Among the documents submitted for the debut, there was a single sheet missing both of our signatures.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
It just... touched my heart a little.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Truly...
the two of us really get to take this on together.
choice_data_list: That's right. You're going to make your dream come true.
That's right. We're going to make your dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...No.
—It's our dream, together.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
Time to write~.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
B, u, e, n, a, V, i, s, t, a…… and done.
Alright, you're next, Trainer! Need the pen?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that fountain pen...!
Is it a graduation commemorative gift from the Trainer Academy?
When I was handed that fountain pen, it truly hit me that I would live my life as a Trainer from now on. Into this pen, I pour my awareness and responsibility as a Trainer—
choice_data_list: (――I'll pour all my strength into you!)
(――I'll pour all my strength into you!)

text_block_list.text: After staring at the documents with both our names side by side for a while... our eyes suddenly meet.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
Let's definitely make it come true, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The dream shared by the two of us.
One greater than what we saw that day—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —It's a promise, then♪

"In search of unseen breathtaking vistas... our days of training
with Buena Vista toward her Twinkle Series debut began!"
